answer_1.quote: We present the first specialized dataset of FPQs, dubbed as FalseQA dataset. Specifically, we first systematically categorize the false premises to ensure the coverage of the dataset. Then we ask human annotators to manually compose the FPQs, as well as explanations for the false premises.
answer_1.outputs: generated explanations and answers to false premise questions

answer_2.quote: we evaluate the quality of the generated explanation by computing the maximum ROUGE-L score between it and the two ground-truth explanations.
